a.lede: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.
a.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs

b.lede: The proposed sale would include explicit conversations with children, officials say.
b.title: State AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from auctioning off users' chat histories
